articles.headline: Japan banks uncover twice the vulnerabilities after Mythos AI release
articles.summary: Banks in Japan found a sharp increase in vulnerabilities linked to the release of Mythos AI, underscoring how AI adoption can expand attack surfaces in regulated industries. For financial institutions and other enterprises, the operational implication is stronger patching, vendor review, and incident-response readiness before deploying new AI tools.

articles.headline: Infineon opens $1.4bn plant near Bangkok to serve EV and data-center demand
articles.summary: Infineon’s new factory in Thailand adds capacity for back-end chip products tied to electric vehicles and data centers, which can ease supply constraints for manufacturers and infrastructure buyers. This matters for businesses planning hardware procurement because it signals continued investment in regional chip capacity and supply-chain diversification.

articles.headline: Nvidia launches Open Agent Safety Platform with broad industry support
articles.summary: Nvidia’s new agent-safety platform is aimed at monitoring and quarantining risky AI agents, which is directly relevant for firms deploying automation in customer service, operations, and internal workflows. The business impact is lower governance risk and a clearer path to safer agent adoption at scale.
